knowledge_gaps: Random-prefix truncation is undefined: specify whether it removes older context while retaining the prediction target or samples an earlier training endpoint, along with truncation probability, length distribution, minimum context and inference behavior.

Matched supervision controls need an explicit design. Changing endpoints or masking positions can change target frequencies, supervised-position counts, negative samples and loss normalization. Match these quantities and optimizer updates where possible; document any remaining differences.

The effective NextItNet context is unverified. Earlier reports describe both a 121-position receptive span and independently encoded ten-item windows. Truncating context outside the actual dependency range may have no effect. Verify the supplied backbone, padding masks, position embeddings and final-nonpadding readout.

Sparse training-prefix perturbation effects do not establish excessive reliance on older history or predict validation improvement. Qualitative judgments about current intent and compatibility remain hypotheses.

The proposal lacks a fixed condition count, runtime allocation, checkpoint-selection rule and paired validation comparison. Preserve all four categories, seed 42, at most 200 epochs and 200 batches per epoch; select using the pinned macro validation HR@10 within the shared budget.

Originality, future potential and implementation difficulty are not rated for the new idea. Earlier diagnostic ratings do not transfer automatically. Resolve the conflict between generic metadata examples and the task's explicit restrictions by using only permitted fields, and preserve the diagnostic interfaces and predictor consistency.
